# TASK-173 — specification

## Scope

Answers you can interact with in Build with AI, after CopilotKit's Open Intelligent UI: the AI can answer with `show_visual` (a weighted comparison, a step-by-step walkthrough or a bar chart) as validated data, drawn by the app's own components. Changing a weight re-ranks the options, steps play and pause, charts have a table view, estimates say where they come from, and "Record … as the decision" or "Use these steps in the document" sends an ordinary message, so anything recorded is still a proposal. No model HTML or JavaScript runs (unlike Open Intelligent UI's sandboxed iframes), and local models without tool calling keep answering in prose.
